acceptance: When the agent-text cap and secret scan land (through #47 or a successor), drop_reason is included: a drop whose reason matches a secret pattern is refused with E_SECRET and leaves the item unchanged, covered by a test
drop_reason's size limit is consistent with the shared agent-text cap, and the CHANGELOG records it
context:
Found 2026-10-31 by the review of the BenchBox drop-reason item.

2026-11-06: PR #47 was closed unmerged; its design is re-landed on tractable by session-state-fields-on-tractable.
description: PR #57 (released in 0.12.0) added drop_reason, validated to at most 2,000 characters with control characters refused, but not secret-scanned. Open PR #47 ('Record decisions, blocked reasons and acceptance progress on tasks', open since 2026-10-17 and now conflicting with main) adds blocked_reason, an 8 KiB cap on agent-written text and E_SECRET scanning. It predates drop_reason, so as written it does not cover it.
